content.text:
1 pound raw beef, ground, medium fat (12%-22%), patty (pan-broiled) cooks down to about 0.73 pounds (331 g) at the USDA cooking yield of 73%; USDA samples ranged 0.71-0.76 pounds. USDA yield is hot cooked weight divided by raw weight of the same piece, measured in USDA research kitchens; your result moves with doneness, trim, bone and pan juices.
